Definition: feminine of a compound of G3501 and G3376 (as noun by implication, of G2250); the festival of new moon:--new moon.
BiblicalUsage: Noumenia is the festival of the new moon, the monthly marker that opened Israel's calendar. Paul names it in Colossians 2:16 among the holy days no one may judge believers over, putting it beside food and drink laws and sabbath days.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the new moon shows how the old calendar pointed to Christ, and once He has come, no festival date can stand between a believer and God.
